notes: §2002:14.8.1.1 grants Format 1 (with and without FROM mnemonic-name-1 and END-ACCEPT) and Format 2 (DATE [YYYYMMDD], DAY [YYYYDDD], DAY-OF-WEEK, TIME, [END-ACCEPT]). All translate, and each Format 2 value has the shape §2002:14.8.1.3 GR7-GR12 give. The --std 2002 run of g2002_accept_formats_1_2 matched the 6 derived lines; Format 3 is declined under §2002:B.3 item 1 with §2002:3.1.5.
